Subject: Q3 planning: proposed strategy & metric sign-off

Team —

Attached is the first full draft of the Q3 priorities and top-level OKRs. I pulled together the cross-functional inputs from product, infra, and sales and focused this draft on three outcome areas we discussed at last week's offsite:

1) Deliver predictable inference cost improvements (latency and unit cost)
   - KR1: Reduce 95th percentile API latency by 18% for hosted workloads
   - KR2: Reduce cost-per-1k-tokens by 22% through batching + quantization pilots

2) Expand enterprise product-market fit
   - KR1: Close 6 new Dedicated deals (>= $50k ARR) in North America
   - KR2: Launch Private deployment in one EU regulated region with SOC2 evidence passed

3) Developer adoption & reliability
   - KR1: Increase weekly active API integrations by 30%
   - KR2: Reduce production incident mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 25%

Please review the KRs and the proposed owners in the attached spreadsheet (Q3_OKR_draft_v3.xlsx). I need explicit sign-off or concrete edits by end-of-day Tuesday (2026-05-05) so I can lock the doc for the board summary on Wednesday.

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Q3ok_example_Q3_OKRs (live doc)
Slides for QBR: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Q3-kickoff-slides

Key asks:
- Laura: confirm go-to-market targets (Dedicated deals) and whether we need to split NA/EU targets
- Jonas: confirm infra owner-level KRs and whether the latency target should be 95th or p99 for the top path
- Grace: review developer adoption campaign alignment and CS involvement

Attaching: Quarter_kickoff_slide_deck_v4.pdf (draft) and Q3_OKR_draft_v3.xlsx

Thanks —
Marcus Lin

Marcus —

Thanks for pulling this together, looks solid overall. Two quick items from GTM:

- Please split the Dedicated deals KR into NA / EU. Our pipeline shows stronger EU POC traction for a subset of regulated customers; committing a single "6 deals" number masks regional variance. Proposed: NA: 4, EU: 2.
- For the Private deployment KR, we need the SOC2 window spelled out (when we'll have audit evidence). If the plan expects a July completion, we should mark a dependency on security/compliance (and I can loop in security ops).

Also: for the cost KR, can we call out a target to pilot the quantized 4-bit flow on two model families (Llama-x, RedGen)? That gives product something actionable.

I have one attachment note: I've added a short appendix in the live doc (link) with customer-facing messaging for Dedicated vs Private.

Laura

Agree with the split Laura suggested. A couple infra notes:

- Latency: I'd keep the primary customer-facing SLO as 95th for the public API but track p99 as a guardrail. For the OKR we should call out both (95th improvement target + p99 stall detection).
